dinner.name: Dutch Stamppot (Dutch Mashed Potatoes and Vegetables)
dinner.description: Dutch mashed potatoes and vegetables with smoked sausage - classic comfort food
ingredients: 1kg waxy potatoes (Yukon Gold), peeled and cubed
400g kale (boerenkool) or sauerkraut or carrots with onions
Salt and white pepper to taste
instructions: Cover cubed potatoes with cold salted water in large pot
Bring to boil; cook 12-15 minutes until nearly fork-tender
If using kale: add roughly chopped kale to pot 5 minutes before potatoes finish cooking
If using sauerkraut: heat in separate pan; add to potatoes after draining
If using carrot and onion: add diced vegetables to potatoes 7-8 minutes before they finish cooking
Return to pot; add butter and warm milk
Mash roughly until chunky (not smooth), leaving some texture
Season generously with salt and white pepper
Meanwhile, pan-fry or grill sausages until cooked through (about 10 minutes)
Serve stamppot in bowls topped with sausage
Garnish with fried onions if desired
dinner.notes: The roughness of the mash is intentional, providing texture contrast to the creamy vegetables
dinner.fun_fact: Stamppot is the definition of Dutch comfort food, traditionally eaten during cold winter months
